fields.description: Greenridge is a townhouse neighbourhood at Emaar South with three- and four-bedroom homes in Grace and Pearl styles. The plans arrange four homes together, with three-bedroom layouts in the middle and four-bedroom layouts at the ends. Ground-floor living spaces open towards a rear terrace.
amenities: Community centre with pool, gym and multipurpose room

overview: Greenridge’s brochure puts the community centre at the heart of everyday recreation, with a pool, gym and multipurpose room. Shaded walking routes, a community garden, outdoor fitness and a basketball court extend that activity outdoors. Interiors use earthy tones and separate family rooms from the service spaces at the front of the homes.
research.locationNote: The project is in Emaar South within Dubai South, with road access towards Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. The wider golf course and community park are nearby amenities; check actual routes, access conditions and a selected home’s outlook rather than assuming all properties face the fairways.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises AED 2.94m. The launch sheet lists three-bedroom homes from AED 2.94m and four-bedroom homes from AED 3.37m. These are historical starting prices, not a current unit quotation or confirmation of available stock.
research.paymentNote: The launch plan combines 10% at booking, seven further 10% payments and 20% on estimated completion. Property Finder reports the same 10/70/20 structure. Later sale or transfer terms may differ.
research.handoverNote: The launch document estimates December 2028 completion, consistent with Property Finder’s Q4 2028 schedule. Confirm the applicable contractual date before purchase.

facts.label: Published unit mix
facts.value: The launch sheet lists 260 three-bedroom and 260 four-bedroom townhouses, totalling 520. Remaining availability is not established by these counts.

facts.label: Grace three-bedroom layout
facts.value: All three bedrooms are upstairs. The ground floor includes living/dining, kitchen, powder room, laundry and a maid’s room with bathroom, with a carport at the front.

facts.label: Four-bedroom arrangement
facts.value: The fourth bedroom is a ground-floor guest room; the other three are upstairs. The main suite has a walk-in wardrobe and balcony.

facts.label: Area definition
facts.value: Published totals include the garage and balcony/terrace allocations. Grace four-bedroom plans separate 2,223.82 sq ft suite, 363.07 sq ft garage and 120.66 sq ft balcony/terrace; these figures do not state plot area.
